name: Inbox digest
description: Mail that reaches your Huddle address is read by NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: what matters is summed up and, once you say yes, sent to your own inbox; the rest goes quietly into your work notes. Needs NEBIUS_API_KEY, and Resend for the mail.
example:
From: Asha (landlord)
Subject: Rent from March

Hi, the rent goes up to ₹28,000 from 1 March. Please confirm by Friday so I can update the agreement.

assistants.name: Reader
assistants.description: Reads email and says what matters.

steps.ask:
Here is an email that just arrived. Answer with JSON only: {"important": true or false, "why": "one sentence", "summary": "two sentences"}.

{{input}}

steps.message: This one matters ({{read.data.why}}). Send yourself the summary?
